messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: RateLimitService generating sustained 429s and quota_mapper errors across prod regions. Page triggered for engineering-oncall. Logs: https://logs.redwood/alerts/1815567890
pagerduty: Page fired -> escalation policy: engineering-oncall. Trigger: sustained 429 spike (50+ r/s) on service `rate-limiter-proxy`.
Carlos M: acked. I'm on it. @pagerduty I acknowledge the page. Checking dashboards now.
Priya K: seeing 429s originating from limiter-v2 pods in us-west-2. CPU and request queue depth increasing. Logs show repeated `quota_mapper: tenant_mismatch` and `quota_misapplied` lines.
Jenna: recent quota-mapper config was deployed 03/10. Could be a bad mapping table. Suggest we try a temporary bypass mapping for impacted tenants before a rollback.
Mateo: agree. If bypass doesn't help we can rollback to stable-20260310 image. Command ready:
```
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/quota-mapper quota-mapper=quay.redwood/quota-mapper:stable-20260310
```
Carlos M: hold on rollback for 60s. Let's attempt bypass for BigCorp and ACME first so customers see less impact.
Priya K: applying bypass now:
```
curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/config/bypass -d '{"tenants":["big-corp","acme"]}'
```
SRE-Bot: bypass config applied to limiter cluster us-west-2. Routing failing requests to fallback pool and marking bypass=true in tracing.
Carlos M: metrics: 429 rate down from ~320/s to ~45/s in the last 30s. Some dedicated customers still throttled though.
Diane L: support case created: INC-5421. Notified account teams for BigCorp and ACME with preliminary advisory. Will follow up with status updates.
Jenna: digging into code path that maps device tokens -> tenant. Repro locally with token set and seeing mismatch when token header contains legacy prefix.
Mateo: scaling limiter nodes while we stabilize: `kops scale --name=prod --replicas limiter=6`. K8s rolling nodes starting.
pagerduty: Reminder: 10 minutes into active P1, platform lead notified if not resolved.
Carlos M: handing off to @Priya K for the overnight watch. I'll pull together a quick summary and timeline in the incident docs.
Priya K: taking it. Current mitigations: bypass applied, limiter scaled, monitoring alerts adjusted to suppress noisy signals. ETA for full remediation: ~3 hours. Will coordinate rollback if mapping fix proves quicker.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to P1. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incident/runbooks/ratelimit-misapplied. Postmortem owner assigned: @Jenna.
Carlos M: :white_check_mark: thanks everyone. I'll update the on-call rotation and tag product + customer ops for follow up. Next update in 30m or on major change. :thumbsup:
